Sand Model.description: Combines deep learning (U-Net CNN) with physics-based Bagnold sand-transport model

Environmental Model.source: persistence of the last 14 observed ERA5 days (no weather forecast feed exists yet)

scheduling.message: Resource-constrained plan on SYNTHETIC crews/equipment/rates and synthetic off-road routing; volumes from the experimental CNN forecast. CP-SAT (Google OR-Tools) solved at least one crew group - see 'scheduler' for per-group solver status; any group that failed/was infeasible fell back to the tested heuristic automatically.
scheduling.optimizer: CP-SAT (Google OR-Tools) constraint-programming schedule, maximising priority-weighted serviced volume under shift/travel-time constraints; automatically falls back to a greedy earliest-finish heuristic if ortools is not installed or the solver can't find a feasible schedule - per-camp when real camp/fleet data is available (see 'scheduler' for which one actually ran)

note: accumulation == deposition (same quantity). Only predicted CHANGE is modelled, no absolute baseline. Sand Model = hybrid CNN+Physics; Environmental Model = physics/weather.
